mark.unitDefinition: The tile is 64u square and the glyph has its own 24u frame; every ratio below is scale-free.

rules: The tile is the identity: one 64u plate, one drawn glyph. Every asset is the same drawing at a different scale.
radius / side stays in 0.20-0.24: a squircle, not a circle and not a sharp square.
glyphCap / side stays in 0.36-0.44: below that it mushes at 16px, above it crowds the plate.
The glyph is a path, never live text: text depends on a font stack and cannot be exported.
The gradient runs at a fixed angle from brass.400 to brass.600; the glyph is brass.950. No third colour.
Variants change the plate, never the letter.
Reverse is ink plate + brass glyph, for brass-heavy or light surfaces.
Clear space is a quarter of the tile side on every side; nothing enters it.
Never stretch, rotate, re-colour, outline, or place the tile below 16px.

exploration.what: The letter lattice the M was first cut on: a 5u cap-height, 1u stroke = 1u gap, orthogonal construction.

assets.use: Primary app icon: brass gradient plate, ink glyph. Self-contained — favicon, app icon, avatar, social.
One colour: currentColor plate with the glyph knocked out. Inline HTML or CSS mask only.
Reverse: ink plate, brass glyph. Self-contained — for brass-heavy or light surfaces.
The M alone, fill=currentColor, 24u square. A quiet secondary mark, not the icon.
Lattice exploration, fill=currentColor. Not the identity — kept as a system proof.
The lattice proved across M E A H N Y. Not a product asset.
